title: Baidu Search Scraper
description: Search Baidu for ranked pages, snippets, source domains, dates, and destination links. Batch Chinese-language queries to monitor visibility or compare search results by topic.

batch.title: Search queries
batch.description: Baidu search phrases. Add one object per phrase.
batch.valueDescription: query used to run this search.

schema.description: Maximum Baidu results to request on each page.

organic_results.title: 对象存储 OSS - 阿里云
organic_results.snippet: Store and retrieve files with scalable cloud object storage from Alibaba Cloud.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Baidu by query for ranked pages, snippets, source domains, dates, and links. Monitor Chinese search visibility and compare rank changes.
storeCopy.intro: Collect Baidu results for multiple phrases, including rank, title, snippet, source, and destination link. Page limits bound collection for each search.
useCases: China-focused SEO teams can check page positions for priority queries.
Content strategists can compare snippets and competing domains by topic.
Publishers can review how Baidu categorizes and dates indexed pages.
howToUse: Add a query object for each phrase in `queries`.
Set `limit` and the starting `page`; use `maxPages` to bound collection.
Compare position, snippet, source, and link fields in the dataset.

faqs.question: How many pages can one query collect?
faqs.answer: Set `maxPages` up to the Actor limit. `maxResults` caps saved rows across every query.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Baidu search-result rank for this page, starting at 1.

fields.name: result_type
fields.description: Baidu result category, such as an organic page or special result.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Page title displayed for the Baidu search result.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Destination URL opened by the Baidu search result.

fields.name: displayed_link
fields.description: Host or shortened address Baidu displays below the result title.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: Text excerpt Baidu displays for the matching page.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Publisher or site name associated with the result.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Content category assigned to this Baidu result when available.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Publication or crawl date displayed with the result, when provided.

fields.name: input_query
fields.description: Chinese or multilingual search phrase submitted to Baidu.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when these Baidu results were collected.
